verdict.rationale: Martin documents a small, fixed set of first-party integrations that a user connects: calendar, inbox and Slack, plus a Todoist to-do import under Settings. That partially covers adding connectors to the assistant. There is no evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps. Missing for 10: a browsable directory or catalog of apps/connectors, support for arbitrary third-party apps beyond the handful of built-ins, and evidence of an in-app add/install flow beyond the per-integration docs.
